reply_text:
I replied in your DM. I can't set up the recurring 09:00 digest. My scheduled jobs run in a fresh session and their output isn't posted back into Slack, so the digest would never reach you. I haven't created anything.

What I can do: when you ask in this DM (for example, "digest of #coastal-team since yesterday"), I'll read #coastal-team, which you're a member of, and reply here with what's new. For a standing daily reminder, your team admin would need to set up a scheduled job that posts to your DM.
